blocks.text: JOLO, Sulu – Provincial officials in Sulu lauded renewed tourism interest from the national government, even as they remind visitors to respect local Islamic traditions, conservative dress codes, and a strict ban on public alcohol consumption. Vice Gov. Abdusakur Tan received a delegation from the Department of Tourism (DOT) led by Assistant Secretary Ferdinand Jose Bagcal and DOT-9 regional director Dara May Cataluña from November 13 to 14. The visit kicked off a two-day validation tour of key cultural and tourist sites across Sulu’s first district under the “Isabela de Basilan and Sulu Cultural Confidence Building: Experience Southern Corridor Tourism Sites” […]...
